findings.title: Auction authority controls auction in unintended way
findings.description:
1. **Description:** The auction authority can set the payment_destination account during auction initialization, and since this account is under their control, they can close it at any time. This causes the Purchase instruction to fail when users attempt to send funds, effectively halting the auction while it is still in progress.
2. **Cause:** The vulnerability arises because the payment_destination account is arbitrarily set by the auction authority and is not a program-derived address (PDA), allowing the authority to close it without constraints.
3. **Exploitation:** An attacker with authority privileges could close the payment_destination token account while the auction is ongoing, causing all future purchase attempts to fail due to the inability to transfer tokens to a closed account.
4. **Impact:** This results in a denial of service for users trying to participate in the auction, undermining the availability and reliability of the auction mechanism.
